newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippines' 7-year coupon rate falls to 14.0 pct.
newsitem.headline: Philippines' 7-year coupon rate falls to 14.0 pct.

text.p: The Philippines' seven-year, fixed rate Treasury notes fetched a lower coupon rate of 14.0 percent at an auction on Tuesday compared with 14.875 percent in October, the Bureau of Treasury said.
The auction generated 4.855 billion pesos worth of bids, of which 2.0 billion pesos were accepted.
The average rate amounted to 13.784 percent, with bids ranging from 13.0 to 14.0 percent.
Dealers said the drop in rates for the seven-year notes was expected due to the planned two percentage-point cut in reserve requirements next year.

The auction, however, drew fewer bids compared to the previous sale which had 8.369 billion pesos worth of tenders. Tuesday's auction was held at the year-end, which is usually a period when banks want to stay liquid, traders added.
